content:
200 Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management successfully created the bulk directive task.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
all_scanners
scanners
directive
Array [
string <UUID>
The UUID of the container where the task is operating.
string <UUID>
The UUID of the directive task.
string <UUID>
The UUID of the scanner (sensor).
string <UUID>
The UUID of the owner.
string
The type of instruction, either restart  or settings .
string
Enum: "pending"
"running"
"completed"
"failed"
"canceled"
The status of the scan task. For a list of scan statuses and their
descriptions, see Scan Status.
integer
The creation date of the directive in unix time milliseconds.
integer
The date the directive was last modified in unix time milliseconds.
integer
The size of the log that the scanner returns when performing a log
directive. This value is always 0  for non-log directives.
object
The instructions to perform.
integer
The time to live for the directive. The status is updated to failed  if
the directive is not executed within the TTL time frame.
string <UUID>
The UUID of the directive task.
]
401 Returned if the API keys specified in your request are invalid.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
container_uuid
uuid
sensor_uuid
owner_uuid
type
status
created
modified
results_blob_size
options
ttl
id
integer
The HTTP status code of the error.
integer
The standard HTTP error name.
string
A brief message about the cause of the error.
— 403 Returned if you do not have the required permissions to send directives to the scanners.
— 404 Returned if the specified scanner or scanners were not found.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
500 Returned if an internal error occurred.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
integer
The HTTP status code of the error.
integer
The standard HTTP error name.
string
A brief message about the cause of the error.
